decision_served: D-SSM-34 (Berk's correction, 2026-08-17, verbatim: 'yaw yanlızca ingilizce nereden çıktı destekleyen tüm diller'): the sung lane targets EVERY registry language. SINGING_PROVEN is per-language and its A9 PER bar needs >=5 lawful human sung recordings with per-recording lyrics per language. EN corpora are on disk (vocadito + LM-SSD); TR's active sub-lane is closed by D-SSM-33; the remaining NINE registry languages (zh, ja, ko, ru, es, fr, de, it, pt — enumerated from generate_music_hybrid_model/music_studio/data/language_registry.json this turn, 11 total) have NO corpus verdict yet. This research produces the per-language lawful-corpus verdicts that gate each language's calibration.

uncertainty: Which lawful (commercial-compatible: CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public domain / permissive custom) human sung-vocal corpora with per-recording lyrics exist for zh, ja, ko, ru, es, fr, de, it, pt — each language ending in LAWFUL CANDIDATE(S) NAMED or NONE EXISTS, so the per-language calibration order can be planned and the gaps reported to the owner honestly.
